summary: Iteration 6 — Admin user management + MoMo failure surfacing verified. Backend 16/16 pytest cases GREEN in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_users_and_momo.py. Verified: GET /api/admin/users returns array, includes admin +250798875272 with role='admin', no _id leaked. Query filter ?q=798875272 works. Non-admin returns 403, no-auth returns 401. Invite flow: POST /admin/users/invite {phone,role='admin'} → {created:true,role:'admin'}, re-invite same phone → {created:false,role:'admin'} (idempotent), email invite works, missing phone+email → 400. PUT /admin/users/{id}/role demotes; self-demotion → 400 'You cannot demote yourself.'. DELETE succeeds; self-delete → 400; delete non-existent → 404. MoMo initiate: BeSoft returned HTTP 200 with debit.status='failed' → response body includes `status:'failed'`, `message:'MoMo declined: provider error [HTTP_400]...'`, `failureReason` (raw BeSoft string). Frontend (mobile 390x844, admin OTP 123456): (1) admin console renders NEW 'Users & Admins' card [data-testid=admin-card-users, icon people-outline] — 5 cards total; (2) Users screen loads 19 users • 3 admins, then 20/4 after invite; (3) YOU badge on current admin row (+250798875272), shield icon disabled (opacity 0.35); (4) users-invite icon opens invite modal with PHONE/EMAIL segmented tabs, invite-value + invite-name + invite-submit ('GRANT ADMIN ACCESS'); (5) invited +250788999124 → new row appears at top with ADMIN badge and orange shield lit, list header updated to 20 users • 4 admins; (6) search 'users-search' with Enter → API-driven filter returns '3 users • 2 admins' matching '798'; (7) PayPal WebView fix present: onShouldStartLoadWithRequest returns false for /paypal/success and /paypal/cancel in both checkout.tsx:168-172 and video/[id].tsx:144-146. All frontend testIDs present and unique per user row: role-toggle-{id}, delete-user-{id}. Deprecated packages / SafeAreaView / other Expo issues: NONE detected in the new admin/users.tsx.

minor.issue: When BeSoft returns HTTP >= 300 (server.py:589-592), the endpoint raises HTTPException(502) and does NOT return the humanized `message` / `failureReason` payload. Only the 2xx-but-failed path (server.py:606-624) surfaces the friendly message. Consider surfacing the humanized message on the 4xx/5xx-from-BeSoft path too, so mobile users always see 'MoMo declined: ...' instead of a raw 'Bad Gateway'.

Invalid plan returns 422 (Pydantic Literal validation) instead of the documented 400 (HTTPException at server.py:534 is unreachable because MoMoInitiateIn.plan is a Literal). Cosmetic only — client sees a 4xx either way.

Existing-user lookup at server.py:1399-1404 handles + / no-+ prefix, but NOT the local Rwanda '0788...' vs '250788...' form. Inviting '+250788555444' when a legacy record exists as '250788555444' (no +) may create duplicates. Observed in live DB: '798875272' (no prefix) coexists with '+250798875272' — both admin — and '+250+250788555444' (double prefix) — likely legacy data pollution.

ui_bugs.issue: Search only triggers on Enter (onSubmitEditing), not while typing. On mobile users typing '798' see no live filter until they tap search key. Add a debounced onChangeText → load(q) for better UX. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/users.tsx:139.

Alert.alert('Delete user?' / 'Remove admin') is a native mobile API; on RN Web it renders as an in-page overlay whose Delete/Remove admin button did not respond to Playwright role-based click. This is the same known limitation flagged in iteration_5 for the Categories screen. Non-blocking for iOS/Android. Consider a custom Modal for web parity. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/users.tsx:70-91 (toggleRole), 94-116 (deleteUser).

issues: Duplicate/dirty admin phone records exist in db.users (e.g. '798875272' without +, '+250798875272' with +, and '+250+250788555444' with double prefix). These are legacy data — not caused by this iteration — but they render as ADMIN rows in the list and can confuse operators. Recommend a one-time DB cleanup migration to normalize phone to E.164 (+250...) and de-duplicate.

action_items: OPTIONAL POLISH: In server.py:589-592, when BeSoft returns HTTP >=300, still return a JSON body with `status:'failed'`, `message` (humanized), `failureReason` instead of raising HTTPException(502). This makes the Android/iOS MoMo failure UX consistent whether the failure is 'HTTP 400 from gateway' or 'debit rejected'.

OPTIONAL POLISH: Add debounced live search in /app/frontend/app/admin/users.tsx:136-147 — replace the onSubmitEditing-only trigger with a 350ms debounce on onChangeText so users see the filter as they type.

OPTIONAL POLISH: Normalize incoming phones in /api/admin/users/invite — always store as E.164 (+250...) and lookup with all three variants (+250xxx, 250xxx, 0xxx) to prevent duplicate admin records. Backfill migration recommended.
OPTIONAL POLISH: For web parity, replace RN Alert.alert on delete-user and role-toggle with a custom in-app confirmation Modal (same fix that was noted for Categories in iteration_5).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1351-1446 admin users CRUD is clean: uses require_admin dependency, safeguards against self-demotion (1373), self-deletion (1436), last-admin removal (1377,1441), returns _clean_user (no _id leak). AdminUserRoleIn uses Literal['user','admin'] via Pydantic → invalid role → 422.

server.py:1388-1431 invite endpoint idempotent — finds existing by phone (with/without +) or email, updates role, returns {created:false}. Otherwise inserts stub user with provider='admin-invite'. Good pattern.
server.py:606-624 MoMo humanization covers 4 failure classes (insufficient / invalid number / not registered / timeout) + fallback 'MoMo declined: <reason[:120]>'. Reasonable.

frontend/app/admin/users.tsx: proper testIDs on every interactive control (users-back, users-invite, users-search, role-toggle-{id}, delete-user-{id}, invite-value, invite-name, invite-submit). isMe protection: current admin's shield is disabled (opacity 0.35) and delete icon hidden (line 217).
frontend/app/admin/index.tsx: CARDS array is data-driven, admin-card-users testID pattern consistent with other cards.

frontend/app/checkout.tsx:168-172 and video/[id].tsx:144-146: onShouldStartLoadWithRequest correctly returns false for /paypal/success and /paypal/cancel so WebView doesn't try to navigate to the (broken) bbkigali.com return page on Android. Matches spec.

rca_of_issue: Original user report 'PAYMENTS NOT WORKING FOR ALL CHANNELS ON ANDROID — payment page opens but errors out' — Root cause on Android: the PayPal WebView return URLs (https://bbkigali.com/paypal/success and /paypal/cancel) point to a static site that is password-protected / not serving those routes, so the WebView showed an error page and the parent app never received a completion signal. FIX applied at /app/frontend/app/checkout.tsx:168-172 and /app/frontend/app/video/[id].tsx:144-146: onShouldStartLoadWithRequest now returns false when the URL matches /paypal/success or /paypal/cancel, letting the parent screen handle the completion event (see checkout.tsx:36-53 and video/[id].tsx:97-112 for the parent handlers). VERIFIED code-level. End-to-end PayPal completion cannot be re-tested here (requires real PayPal login — explicitly excluded per review request). For MoMo, the earlier 'errors out' was a bare 502/HTTPException with no user-facing text; now the response body includes a humanized `message` field ('MoMo declined: ...', 'Insufficient MoMo balance...', etc.) that the frontend surfaces to the user. VERIFIED via live BeSoft call — 200 response with message:'MoMo declined: provider error [HTTP_400]: unexpected status 400: (retryable: false)'.
